title: The application-datatable blueprint ships on the shelf and its probe pack refuses ship on a broken surface
asA: shelf consumer applying the application-datatable v1.0.0 blueprint
iWant: the shipped blueprint files, its Playwright probe pack, and a sample-app fixture proving both to load, apply and gate ship the way the T-0 runner extension expects
soThat: a project consuming rcf-lite gets the datatable ACs, the pack that runs them, and a golden fixture the pack refuses on a broken surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: The shelf carries blueprints/application-datatable/blueprint.json declaring slug application-datatable, version 1.0.0, category application, and 22 contributions (6 REQs, 9 USs, 3 TACs, 4 ADRs); the suggestedCompanions array declares logging and errorHandling with reasons from the ratified spec section 5.1.

rcf define blueprint add ./blueprints/application-datatable applies the 22 contributions cleanly on a fresh init project; rcf define validate reports the tree clean; both rcf audit coverage --strict and rcf audit eval coverage --strict exit 0 on the scratch project.

The shipped probe pack blueprints/application-datatable/probe-packs/application-datatable.pack.js loads via T-0's pack-loader against a scratch project with the blueprint applied; each of its six check ids (AC-17101-1, AC-17102-1, AC-17103-2, AC-17104-3, AC-17105-1, AC-17106-1) resolves to an AC id contributed by the blueprint per T-0 AC-1701-3.

The sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-application-datatable/ ships a dependency-free Node HTTP server (server.js) with a start script; when started, its shell route realises every surface the pack's six checks probe, and running the pack against the fixture returns verdict=pass on every check (severity block, aggregate pass).

The probe pack refuses ship on a broken fixture: with the aria-live status region wrapper removed from the shell, running the pack returns verdict=fail on AC-17103-2 at severity=block and the aggregate verdict is block.
